guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以吸附平衡、床層傳質、穿透與再生為主線，從目標物與競爭背景、批次等溫線、空床接觸時間、處理床體積數進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops adsorption equilibrium, bed transfer, breakthrough and regeneration through ten connected units, beginning with targets and competing background, batch adsorption isotherms, empty-bed contact time, treated bed volumes. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

evidence: 在離線工作台先選取「目標物與競爭背景」的觀測點。採流量加權目標物樣本，保留分析檢出限與空白。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「批次等溫線」的觀測點。以平衡批次數據擬合並用未參與擬合的濃度點驗證。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「空床接觸時間」的觀測點。將床體積與累積床體積數、出口濃度一起觀察。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「處理床體積數」的觀測點。把 C/C0 對床體積數作突破曲線。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「傳質區與穿透曲線」的觀測點。同時取入口、出口樣本，避免入口突變造成誤判。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「容量與質量保守估計」的觀測點。使用小柱或現場突破資料校正工作容量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「多床串聯與採樣」的觀測點。同時取入口、出口樣本，避免入口突變造成誤判。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「生物活性與壓損」的觀測點。比較進出測壓管水頭並記錄水溫與流量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「換碳、再生與殘餘物」的觀測點。使用小柱或現場突破資料校正工作容量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「成效與資料可追溯」的觀測點。把 C/C0 對床體積數作突破曲線。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
evidenceEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for targets and competing background. Collect flow-weighted target-compound samples with detection limits and blanks. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for batch adsorption isotherms. Fit equilibrium batch data and validate with held-out concentration points. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for empty-bed contact time. Track bed volume alongside cumulative bed volumes and outlet concentration. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for treated bed volumes. Plot C/C0 against bed volumes as a breakthrough curve. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for mass-transfer zone and breakthrough curve. Sample inlet/outlet together to avoid misreading feed changes. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for capacity and mass-based estimates. Calibrate working capacity with small-column or field breakthrough data. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for series beds and sampling. Sample inlet/outlet together to avoid misreading feed changes. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for biological activity and head loss. Compare inlet/outlet piezometric heads and record temperature and flow. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for replacement, regeneration and residuals. Calibrate working capacity with small-column or field breakthrough data. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for performance and data traceability. Plot C/C0 against bed volumes as a breakthrough curve. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
pitfalls: 用總有機碳數字代替特定微量污染物。診斷與介入：核對微克換算與流量加權濃度，保留分析空白。
直接把單溶質平衡容量當動態床可用容量。診斷與介入：補測競爭背景與不同濃度，將平衡容量和動態壽命分開。
在 EBCT 又乘孔隙率造成定義混亂。診斷與介入：確認使用總床體積定義，將短流與傳質效果另驗證。
原水濃度改變仍用固定 BV 預測壽命。診斷與介入：同步畫累積床體積與污染質量，不只比較運轉日數。
只到出水明顯升高才建立第一筆資料。診斷與介入：檢查床前後同時採樣與檢出限，沿時間建立穿透曲線。
以新碳名稱或表面積保證固定壽命。診斷與介入：用中試動態容量及競爭水質校正，規劃穿透前後的採樣。
只量總出口而不知道前床何時穿透。診斷與介入：檢查床前後同時採樣與檢出限，沿時間建立穿透曲線。
碳床出水改善全歸因仍有大量吸附容量。診斷與介入：比較分層測壓、流量與水溫，區分堵塞與流量變化。
再生後僅看重量便宣稱全部性能恢復。診斷與介入：用中試動態容量及競爭水質校正，規劃穿透前後的採樣。
只有出口曲線就宣稱材料效能提升。診斷與介入：同步畫累積床體積與污染質量，不只比較運轉日數。
pitfallsEn: Total organic carbon substitutes for a specific trace contaminant. Diagnostic response: Check microgram conversion and flow-weighted concentration, retaining analytical blanks.
Single-solute equilibrium capacity is used as dynamic-bed capacity. Diagnostic response: Add competing-background/concentration tests and separate equilibrium capacity from dynamic life.
Porosity is inserted into EBCT, confusing definitions. Diagnostic response: Confirm the bulk-bed-volume definition and validate bypass/mass transfer separately.
A fixed BV life is used despite changed influent concentration. Diagnostic response: Plot cumulative bed volumes and contaminant mass together, not runtime alone.
Monitoring starts only after a large effluent rise. Diagnostic response: Check simultaneous bed samples/detection limits and build a time-based breakthrough curve.
A carbon label or surface area is used to guarantee life. Diagnostic response: Refine with pilot dynamic capacity/competing water quality and plan breakthrough sampling.
Only final effluent is measured, hiding lead-bed breakthrough. Diagnostic response: Check simultaneous bed samples/detection limits and build a time-based breakthrough curve.
Improved effluent is attributed only to unused adsorption capacity. Diagnostic response: Compare multi-level heads, flow and temperature to distinguish clogging from changed flow.
Recovered mass alone is used to claim restored performance. Diagnostic response: Refine with pilot dynamic capacity/competing water quality and plan breakthrough sampling.
An outlet curve alone is used to claim improved media performance. Diagnostic response: Plot cumulative bed volumes and contaminant mass together, not runtime alone.

history.title: 顆粒活性碳吸附
history.text: 本課以公開技術手冊建立方法背景；來源出版年代不代表此程序首次發明的年代。舊版文件僅提供原理與歷史脈絡，現場工作仍須確認當地現行規定與設備文件。
history.textEn: Public technical manuals establish the methodological background; publication dates do not identify the invention date. Older documents provide principles and historical context, while real work still requires current local requirements and equipment documentation.

courses.connection: 本課以吸附平衡、床層傳質、穿透與再生為主線，從目標物與競爭背景、批次等溫線、空床接觸時間、處理床體積數進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
courses.connectionEn: This course develops adsorption equilibrium, bed transfer, breakthrough and regeneration through ten connected units, beginning with targets and competing background, batch adsorption isotherms, empty-bed contact time, treated bed volumes. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
